User-agent: *
Allow: /

# /api/content.php MUST stay crawlable: the SPA fetches it while rendering.
# Blocking all of /api/ made Googlebot render an empty "content unavailable"
# page on every URL, which took the whole site out of the index.
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /api/save.php
Disallow: /api/login.php
Disallow: /api/logout.php
Disallow: /api/upload.php
Disallow: /api/auth-status.php

Sitemap: https://pavlokovach.art/sitemap.xml
